title: 第15章 四类弟子
slug: 掠天记全本免费-掠天记最新章节列表
content_zh:
此言对也不对，对两种人来说，修行生活自然是逍遥自在的。
一种是拥有充足资源的，每日里除了修行，便是访友论道，品茶煮酒，谈修行心得，论当世剑仙，朝赏旭日，暮送夕霞，逍遥的不能再逍遥。
另外一种呢，就是完全没有资源且放弃了希望的，反正自己无论如何也赚不来足够的修行资源了，那就得过且过吧，终日在自己房间里抱头昏睡，又或是满山遍野的乱逛，希翼着会偶然发现一个前贤洞府，或是被道门长老看重，收为衣钵，从此接着逍遥自在。
而除了这两种人之外，道门的生活却是紧张而忙碌着。
前期的修行，拼得就是一个资源，有资源，便能突飞猛进，无资源，便会停滞不前。
胖道人就是这样一个人，按照他目前的条件，别人早就放弃了，但他还在终日奔走，为每三个月两块灵石的资源奔波劳碌着，虽然这两块灵石也无法给他带来多大的帮助，但他却乐此不疲，将毫无希望的修行生涯用一种充满了希望的态度快乐的活了下来……
以上，便是方行对胖道人整体的认识与评价。
这倒也罢了，方行不会去戮破胖道人对于修行路上抱有的梦幻泡沫，因为他就是指望这个泡沫活着的，若是连个希望也没有的话，鬼知道胖道人会颓废成什么样子。
但偏偏胖道人还是个极热心的家伙，在自觉与方行做了朋友之后，除了每个月替方行缴纳一百两银子的膳食费到膳司监去，还有义务提醒方行小小年纪，不要变得这么懒，天天在房间里睡觉是没有修行资源可赚取的，你还是乖乖的跟我去杂司监领份工比较好……
油水不浅呢！
“除了每个月的散碎银子，还有其他油水可捞，要不然你以为我这每个月替你缴纳的百两银子是从哪里来的？当然了，更重要的，就是这每三个月一块的灵石了，这就等于比别的丁级资质弟子多了一倍的资源，方师弟，你真的不动心吗？哎哟，别捂耳朵嘛……”
胖道人在喝酒的时候，还不忘在方行耳边絮絮叨叨，一副苦口婆心的模样。
在他看来，方行如今已经变成了道门里的二流子了，每天吃了睡，睡了吃，灵石没有了，也一点都不着急，别的二流子，再没用也经常跑出去凑凑热闹，看看道门里的风景并想想能不能碰碰运气呢，可这小子倒好，连外出看风景也省了，整日憋在木屋里不见人。
“再说就给我滚出去……”
方行捂着耳朵大叫，恨不得一脚把胖道人踢飞。
小爷一个坐拥三十几块灵石的人，还需要去你们杂司监跑腿？
每天节省时间修行还不够呢！
当然，这些话却不能跟胖道人说，至少目前是不能的。
“好好好，我不说了……”
胖道人摆着手，过了一会，却又忍不住道：“那你修行的资源怎么办？”

方行翻了个白眼：“不是快到发放灵石的时候了吗？”
胖道人道：“三个月就这么一块灵石，哪够呀，而且还不一定拿到手里呢……”
方行不屑的瞥了他一眼，心想你三个月两块灵石也不够！
见胖道人还欲再说，方行急忙一挥手：“得，你别再劝了，我是懒得去你们杂司监，那里都是什么人我又不是不清楚，你上次请他们喝酒，一个个修为不怎么高吧，还拽得二五八万似的，如果不是你使劲跟我使眼色，我就直接拿酒坛子砸他了，还做工呢，难道让我也去拍那群浑蛋们的马屁去？省省吧，我惟一有可能去你们杂司监的理由，就是砸了那破地方！”
胖道人有些无语，想想这是，小王八蛋年龄不大，脾气可不小，不过还是不忍心看这么一个大好少年就此颓废下去，沉默了一会，还是嘟嚷了一句：“灵石总得赚呀……”
方行嗤的一声笑了，道：“早晚让你看看我是怎么赚灵石的！”
事情来的也快，没多久，便到了道门发放灵石的时候，这可是道门大事，不知多少道门弟子翘首以待，就等着每三个月的这一次灵石发放呢，而且这一次的发放阵势不小，毕竟这一个月可是大发放，也就是外门弟子，无论甲乙丙丁等资质，都有灵石可以领取。
丁级资质的弟子每三个月有一块灵石领取，丙级资质每两个月有一块，乙级资质每一个月有一块，甲级资质则是每个月两块，四类弟子，平时领取灵石的时间虽然都是月中十五这一天，但因为频率不同，所以也很难遇到四类弟子同时领取灵石的盛况。

content_en:
This statement is correct or not. For both kinds of people, the spiritual life is naturally free and easy.
One type has sufficient resources. In addition to practicing every day, they spend time visiting friends and discussing Taoism, tasting tea and wine, talking about their cultivation experiences, discussing the swordsmen of the world, admiring the rising sun in the morning, and seeing the sunset in the evening. Those who are carefree can no longer be carefree.
The other kind is those who have no resources at all and have given up hope. Since they can't earn enough resources for practice anyway, they can just live life and sleep in their own rooms all day long, or wander around in the mountains and plains, hoping that they will stumble upon a former sage's cave, or be valued by a Taoist elder, take him as his mantle, and live happily ever after.
Apart from these two kinds of people, Daomen's life is tense and busy.
In the early stage of practice, all you need is a resource. If you have resources, you can make rapid progress. If you don't have resources, you will stagnate.
Fat Taoist is such a person. According to his current conditions, others have given up long ago, but he is still running around all day long, working hard for the resources of two spiritual stones every three months. Although these two spiritual stones cannot bring him much help, he is still happy with it and happily survives his hopeless cultivation career with an attitude full of hope...
The above is Fang Xing’s overall understanding and evaluation of Fat Taoist.
That's okay, Fang Xing will not burst the bubble of dreams that the fat Taoist has about his spiritual path, because he is counting on this bubble to survive. If there is no hope, who knows how decadent the fat Taoist will be.
But the fat Taoist is still a very enthusiastic guy. After consciously becoming friends with Fang Xing, in addition to paying Fang Xing's meal fee of 100 taels to the Food Supervisor every month, he also has the obligation to remind Fang Xing, at a young age, not to become so lazy. There are no spiritual resources to earn from sleeping in the room every day. It is better for you to follow me and go to the Miscellaneous Supervisor to get a job...
The oil and water are not shallow!
"In addition to the scattered silver every month, there are other things to earn. Otherwise, where do you think the hundred taels of silver I pay for you every month come from? Of course, what is more important is the spiritual stone that is given every three months. This is equivalent to twice as many resources as other D-level disciples. Junior Brother Fang, are you really not tempted? Oops, don't cover your ears..."
While the fat Taoist was drinking, he did not forget to chatter in Fang Xing's ears, looking very sincere.
In his opinion, Fang Xing has now become a second-rate kid in the Taoist sect. He eats and sleeps every day. He has no spiritual stone and is not anxious at all. The other second-rates, no matter how useless they are, often run out to join in the fun, look at the scenery in the Taoist sect and think about whether they can try their luck.
"If you say anything else, get out of here..."
Fang Xing covered his ears and shouted, wishing he could kick the fat Taoist away.
Young Master, a man with more than thirty spiritual stones, still needs to run errands with your Miscellaneous Supervisor?
Saving time every day to practice is not enough!
Of course, these words cannot be said to the fat Taoist, at least not for now.
"Okay, okay, I won't say anything anymore..."
The fat Taoist waved his hands. After a while, he couldn't help but said: "What about the resources for your practice?"
Fang Xing rolled his eyes: "Isn't it almost time to distribute the spirit stones?"
The fat Taoist said: "Three months is just such a spiritual stone, it's not enough, and it's not guaranteed to be in your hands..."
Fang Xing glanced at him disdainfully, thinking that two spiritual stones for three months would not be enough for you!
Seeing that the fat Taoist wanted to say more, Fang Xing hurriedly waved his hand: "Okay, stop trying to persuade me. I'm too lazy to go to your miscellaneous department supervisor. I don't know who the people are there. Last time you invited them to drink, they were all not very cultivated, and they were worth 25,800 yuan. If you hadn't winked at me, I would have justI hit him with a wine jar and he was still working. Do you want me to flatter those bastards? Save it, the only reason why I might go to your office as supervisor is to destroy that lousy place! "
The fat Taoist was a little speechless. Thinking about it, the little bastard was young and had a bad temper. However, he still couldn't bear to see such a good young man sinking into decadence. After being silent for a while, he still muttered: "You have to earn spiritual stones..."
Fang Xing sneered and said, "Sooner or later I'll let you see how I earn spiritual stones! "
Things happened quickly, and not long after, it was time for the Taoist sect to distribute spiritual stones. This was a major event for the Taoist sect. I don’t know how many disciples of the Taoist sect were eagerly waiting for the spiritual stone distribution every three months, and this time the distribution was not small. After all, this month was a big distribution, that is, the outer sect disciples, regardless of their qualifications such as A, B, C, D, etc., all the spiritual stones could be received.
Disciples with D-level qualifications can receive one spiritual stone every three months, C-level qualifications can receive one piece every two months, B-level qualifications can receive one piece every month, and A-level qualifications can receive two pieces per month. Although the four types of disciples usually receive spiritual stones on the fifteenth day of the month, due to the different frequencies, it is difficult to encounter the grand occasion of the four types of disciples receiving spiritual stones at the same time.
